name: text-subtitle-cps-timing
title: Japanese Subtitle 4 cps
description: Mỗi câu phụ đề hiện bằng nhát cắt và đứng đúng thời lượng tính theo số chữ (tiếng Nhật 4 chữ mỗi giây, tối thiểu 0.5 giây), có quãng nghỉ ngắn giữa các câu.

moworks.author: takayu

options.cues: subtitle lines (a newline breaks the line; two lines at most)
options.rate: characters a second (17 for Vietnamese; 4 for Japanese)
options.gap: s between cues (0.12: three frames at 24 fps)
options.meta: an optional readout of the timing

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-jp-subtitle-timing, written here): Cue time = max(0.5 s, chars ÷ 4) (half-width chars count 0.5); ≤ 13 chars per line, ≤ 2 lines; 0.12 s gap (3 frames at 24 fps) between cues; schedule scaled to fit if longer; '、' → space, final '。' dropped, inner '。' → full-width space. Text 15 px, white with a 3.5 px dark outline, centred at the bottom of the picture; cuts only. Demo: cues from 0.35 s. Loop 4.6 s. For Vietnamese use a Latin-script rate (≈ 17 chars/s). Params: tốc độ đọc (4 chữ/s; tiếng Việt ≈ 17 ký tự/s) · tối đa (13 chữ × 2 dòng) · tối thiểu (0.5 s) · nghỉ (3 khung). Cue length = max(0.5 s, characters ÷ rate), cut in and out; the plan is scaled to fit when longer.
